description: Resolves the local currency from an IP address's geolocation and converts an amount into it using the latest rate. Useful for localizing prices for a visitor. The target currency is returned in the 'to' field. Growth plan and above.

amount.description: Amount to convert. Must be greater than 0. Default is 1.0.

from.description: Currency code to convert from, e.g. 'USD'.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to geolocate. Omit to use the caller's own IP address.

name: ip_to_currency
title: Convert to the local currency of an IP address
